name: @cotal-ai/website
description: Cotal documentation site powered by Next.js and Fumadocs.

scripts.build: npm run sync && next build --webpack && node scripts/export.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && node scripts/check-migration.mjs && node scripts/check-start-here.mjs && node scripts/check-operate-mesh.mjs && node scripts/check-connect-agents.mjs && node scripts/check-build-integrations.mjs && node scripts/check-api-reference.mjs && node scripts/check-fundamentals.mjs && node scripts/assert-plain-markdown.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run sync && fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && tsc --noEmit
